# EnterpriseGlue v0.40.4 Release Notes

Generated from release-note fragments changed since `v0.40.3`.

## Highlights

- **frontend:** Starts workspace dashboard queries early and displays each dashboard section as its data becomes available.

## User and administrator impact

- The built-in organization dashboard can open while installed frontend plugins initialize.
- Dashboard values have independent loading states so completed sections can be used while other sections are still loading.

## Database migrations

- Database rollback supported for the combined release: yes.

## Security

- Early dashboard reads require a verified organization session and the existing dashboard permission.

## Documentation

- The dashboard uses the existing tenant-scoped API and preserves authorization for installed plugin routes.

## Published packages

| Package | Previous | New | Impact |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| `@enterpriseglue/frontend-host` | `0.21.3` | `0.21.4` | patch |

## Rollback

- Redeploy the previous compatible application images.

## Validation evidence

- Browser checks exercise dashboard data arriving independently of plugin loading and other dashboard requests.

- Release-note fragments: `progressive-dashboard-loading`
